ModuleName: 2 -Building a Full Website with HTML, Images, and Links

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Covers the structure and topics of the module, including multi-page website architecture, semantic HTML elements, embedding images with proper attributes, and creating hyperlinks, serving as a navigational outline for learners and instructors to understand what the module addresses.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: A navigational overview page listing all topics covered in the module — from multi-page website structure through semantic HTML, images, links, and navigation — giving learners and instructors a high-level roadmap of the module's content.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Multi-Page Website Structure
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how multi-page websites are organized, how individual HTML pages are structured, and how they interconnect, providing learners with the foundational concepts they need before building their own sites.

Artifacts.Name: Semantic HTML Markup
Artifacts.Description: A reading covering semantic HTML elements — what they are, why choosing meaningful tags matters for browsers, search engines, and assistive technologies, and how learners should apply them when structuring web page content.

Artifacts.Name: Embedding Images in HTML
Artifacts.Description: A reading explaining how to embed images in HTML using the img element, covering correct syntax, file paths, alt text for accessibility, and best practices for displaying images responsibly on a web page.

Artifacts.Name: Creating Hyperlinks
Artifacts.Description: A reading explaining how hyperlinks work in HTML, covering the anchor element, href attribute, absolute versus relative URLs, and how links connect pages and resources across the web.

Artifacts.Name: Internal Navigation and Site Linking
Artifacts.Description: A reading focused on building internal navigation within a multi-page site, covering how to use relative file paths and anchor elements to link between an author's own pages and sections.

Artifacts.Name: External Links and Web Resources
Artifacts.Description: A reading covering external linking in HTML, including how to write correct URLs, when and how to open links in a new tab, and security considerations such as the rel='noopener noreferrer' attribute.

Artifacts.Name: Bringing It All Together: Building a Complete Website
Artifacts.Description: A reading that synthesizes all prior module skills — semantic markup, image embedding, and linking — into a guided walkthrough of planning and building a complete, coherent multi-page website from scratch.
